observations: CRITICAL STRUCTURAL FINDING: This page's header AND opening body text both closely duplicate p34 and p37 respectively, AND its embedded diagram is visually identical in layout to p34's diagram. Combined with the earlier-noted p32/p36 and p33/p35 near-duplications, there is now a strong pattern across PDF pages 32-38 (leaves יד-יז, 14-17) of repeated/echoed content at a roughly 4-page (2-leaf) interval. The most parsimonious explanation consistent with the evidence is that this specific Google Books scan may have some pages double-imaged, OR the physical exemplar's gathering of leaves 14-17 has a genuine printing anomaly (e.g. a repeated forme in the original 1883 print run), OR -- less likely given the diagram match -- the Bahir's own text at this point contains a deliberate structural refrain reinforced by the editor repeating the diagram. This scan does NOT resolve which explanation holds and explicitly declines to silently merge or de-duplicate these pages; each is preserved as its own independent PDF-page artifact per the lossless-reconstruction mandate. RECOMMENDATION for human/GPT review: compare PDF pages 32 vs 36, 33 vs 35 (already diagrammed identical opening), and 34 vs 38 side-by-side at full resolution, and if confirmed as a scan/print duplication, note it explicitly in the counterpart integration record -- but do not alter this scan's raw artifacts, which preserve the PDF as encountered.
